description.narrative: The project is expected to create direct jobs across Latin America, India, and Indonesia through the addition of new screens, offering youth training and first-job opportunities. In addition, Cinepolis will deepen the competitiveness of the movie theater sector in India via by introducing innovative customer experiences that push the sector and competitors towards innovation and becoming lifestyle-oriented venues amid streaming and gaming competition. Additionally, the transaction will establish Latin Americas first Sustainability-Linked Loan in the creative industries, incorporating climate and gender-focused KPIs and creating a replicable model for socially sustainable financing

The proposed investment involves an unsecured corporate loan of up to US$300 million (comprising US$ 102 million A Loan and up to US$ 198 million through potential mobilization efforts) to Exhibidora Mexicana Cinepolis, S.A. de C.V. (Cinepolis) to support its investment plan across Latin America, India, and Indonesia. The facility will be structured as a Sustainability-Linked Loan. The loan proceeds will finance Cinepoliss unfunded investments over the period between 2025 and 2027, including new theater openings, expansion and renovation of existing locations, digitalization initiatives, and the growth of Cinepolis Distribución.
